cheapest_decisive_test.action: scripts/run_t20261006_15_intraday_rules.py: group A and B on the 17 ETF minute panels (all registered versions, depth curves over 1/2/4/15/17 symbols, cost x0.5/1/2/4), then C and D when data are ready; results.json.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: A version/portfolio passes P1 paper incubation only if recent-window net Sharpe is positive with DSR >= 0.7, net placebo percentile >= 0.9 and >= 3 of the robustness checks of config/evaluation-standard-v2.json hold.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: A group is called not holding only if the reproduction, faithful-implementation, three-depth-point, budget and power conditions are all met and the best depth-point recent net Sharpe is <= 0 or its placebo percentile < 0.9; otherwise it is reported as not at depth.

cost_and_execution_assumptions: Signal on the close of minute bar t, fill at the open of bar t+1, flat at the close of the 15:59 bar (stand-in for a market-on-close). ETF cost per side = half spread (tick cents prior) + 0.02 bp slippage, sells + 0.206 bp SEC fee, fills before 09:45 ET + 1.0 bp, reported at x0.5, x1, x2, x4. Stocks use equity_book costfn (open snapshot for entries, close snapshot for exits, mean for stops), spread part x0.5, x1, x2. Stops are market orders. No borrow fee (easy-to-borrow intraday). Paper fills are NBBO-based and optimistic on size.
existing_solution_comparison: Published: ZAB 2024 (SPY Sharpe 1.33 with VWAP stop and volatility targeting, base 0.61), Gao et al. 2018 (SPY Sharpe 1.08 gross, 1993-2013), Baltussen et al. 2021 (futures out-of-sample R2 up to 2.9 percent), ZBA 2024 (Sharpe 2.81, commission only), QuantConnect 2016-only replication (2.40), Concretum 2026-07 (plain ORB SPY Sharpe 0.14). No source gives an independent live record net of spread. The 2026-10-06 survey I-20261006-01 found no candidate with hard net evidence. Reuse: published rules implemented as written; only data adaptation, cost, current validity and execution feasibility are new.
negative_experiments_checked: Registry (oc research directions) last rows 2026-10-06 read: spy_noise_band_intraday refuted (gross about 3.6 percent a year, only SPY, every-minute rule, 0.30 vs 0.61 unexplained), single_etf_intraday_momentum_cost_adjusted refuted (effective N 3, one symbol set), orb_etf_opening_range_breakout (placebo 92.7-92.9 percent, kept as narrow), orb_stocks_in_play_relative_volume refuted (select window -27.1 percent a year, stop-fill dependent, design window 2016-2022 never run, fixed top 20, no liquidity buckets), cross_sectional_gap_fade refuted, minute_bar_momentum_multipath partial (IEX only), reversal_trend_user_indicator refuted at 18 hourly cells 2024+ long-only, reversal_trend_daily_signals partial. Differences: paper rule semantics (HH:00/HH:30), 4x3x3x3x2 versions across 17 symbols with depth curves, reproduction on 2016-2022, full pool depth for ORB, 1-minute Reversal Trend and long-short hourly.
objective: T-20261006-15: do published intraday rules (noise band, market intraday momentum, stocks-in-play ORB, Reversal Trend) keep a net-of-cost edge in 2024-01-08..2026-10-06 once run at depth (reproduction, faithful rule, three or more scale points, full registered grids, power)?

sources.applicability: Group A rule, parameters (VM 0.5-2, lookback 7/14/28, stop variants, vol target) and the paper cell.
sources.claim: Zarattini, Aziz and Barbon (SFI WP 24-97, 2024): SPY intraday momentum with a time-of-day Noise Area = max/min(open, previous close) x (1 +/- VM x sigma), sigma the mean absolute move from the open over the previous 14 days at the same minute; positions are set only at HH:00 and HH:30, stopped by the current band and the VWAP, flat at the close; with volatility targeting (2%, leverage cap 4) 2007-2024 gave 19.6 percent a year, Sharpe 1.33, 1.8 trades a day; the base opposite-band version gave Sharpe 0.61.
sources.independent_replication: Local H-20260922-07 reproduced 2.2 percent a year and Sharpe 0.30 (persist entries each minute); a third-party automated replication reported 0.41. Not reproduced yet with the half-hourly rule; this iteration does it.
sources.limitations: Author-reported, no out-of-sample split; costs only $0.0045 per share; paper itself says the optimum is VM 1.5 and lookback 90, so 14/1 is not an ex-post optimum.
sources.market_and_period: SPY, 2007-05 to 2024-04, 1-minute IQFeed bars, commission $0.0035 + slippage $0.001 per share

sources.applicability: Group B predictors (first half-hour with and without overnight, plus the twelfth half-hour) and trading window 15:30-16:00.
sources.claim: Gao, Han, Li and Zhou (JFE 2018): the first half-hour return of SPY measured from the previous close predicts the last half-hour return (R2 1.6 percent, 2.6 percent with the twelfth half-hour; out-of-sample 1.2 and 1.8 percent), a sign-timing strategy earns 6.67 percent a year at 6.19 percent volatility, Sharpe 1.08, before costs, 1993-2013.
sources.independent_replication: Baltussen-Da-Lammers-Martens (JFE 2021) find the same last-30-minute pattern in 60+ futures 1974-2020.
sources.limitations: Gross of costs, sample ends 2013; effect said stronger on volatile and high-volume days.
sources.market_and_period: SPY and ten other ETFs, 1993-2013, 30-minute returns, gross of costs

sources.applicability: Group C rule, universe filters and stop sizes.
sources.claim: Zarattini, Barbon and Aziz (SSRN 4729284): 5-minute opening range breakout traded only on the top 20 stocks by relative volume, stop at 10 percent of ATR14, flat at close, 2016-2023 about 7,000 US stocks: IRR 41.6 percent, Sharpe 2.81 versus 3.2 percent and 0.48 without the relative-volume filter; 0.08R per trade, commission only.
sources.independent_replication: QuantConnect research (2016 only, 1,000 liquid stocks) reports Sharpe 2.40; its comments flag stop fills one bar late and a win rate near 17 percent.
sources.limitations: No spread or slippage; stop fills in the original are intrabar at the stop price; author-reported.
sources.market_and_period: US stocks 2016-2023, 5-minute bars, commission $0.0035 per share, no spread or slippage

sources.claim: Baltussen, Da, Lammers and Martens (JFE 2021): in 60+ futures 1974-2020 the return of the last 30 minutes is positively predicted by the return in the rest of the day; linked to gamma hedging of options market makers and leveraged ETFs; out-of-sample R2 up to about 2.9 percent for equity index futures.
sources.limitations: Futures not ETFs; effect reverts over following days.

stop_condition: Per group, frozen in hypotheses.md: a rule is called 'not holding' only if reproduction, faithful implementation, at least three depth points, the full registered grid and power are all satisfied; otherwise 'not at depth' with the next step written. Budget: 4,203 registered versions, 4 compute-hours on this box plus at most 4 USD on Modal, 2026-10-10 22:00 UTC deadline. No change to versions, windows, gates or costs after results.
target_regime_and_horizon: Decision window 2024-01-08 to the end of data (2026-10-06, 689 sessions), split into the 11 market phases of reports/research/program/regimes-2026-10-01 (P11 extended to data end); 2016-2023 is a diagnostic and reproduction window only (the published samples end 2023-2024, so 2016-2022 is the in-sample reproduction and 2023 onward the true out-of-sample). Holding periods: minutes to one session (A, B, C, D-1m); D-1h up to 26 hourly bars. Validity ends when the forward 63-session net mean falls below zero.
